# PDF.js

Vendored from Mozilla `pdfjs-dist` version **5.6.205**, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
The minified browser module and worker are renamed to `pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs`.
Character maps, standard fonts and WASM decoders retain their upstream names.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v5.6.205

Used exclusively by the private-document reader. No document bytes are bundled.
